findings.problem: The bucket is a rolling window (notifications-model.ts:140, todayStart-6d to yesterday), not the calendar week. Chinese 本周 strictly means the calendar week, so on a Monday, items from last Thu-Sat would sit under 本周早些时候 and the label would be wrong. English "this week" is looser.
findings.suggestion: 前几天 (matches "2-6 days ago"; reads naturally between 昨天 and 更早)

findings.problem: These are correct as durations (schedules "{label}后", "已逾期{label}", the transcript elapsed time). But the same keys are also used as ages in the session drawer row time (session-projection.ts:402-409) and the Team Bridge row stamp (team-bridge/model.ts:616-620). A bare "3小时" or "2年" in a row timestamp reads as a length of time, not "3 hours ago". This comes from reusing one key for two meanings; a translation of the shared key cannot fix it.
findings.suggestion: Keep the draft. Upstream (code, not this catalogue): make the row stamps use relative.*_ago_compact (#分钟前/#小时前/#天前), and add week/year ago keys (#周前/#年前). Non-gating.

findings.problem: At two-digit counts these are 6 terminal cells ("59分钟", "47小时") against a "~4 characters" tight-token hint, and they sit in narrow row-meta slots (Team Bridge row stamp, session drawer). No shorter idiomatic form exists: 分 alone is ambiguous in a bare stamp and 时 alone is not idiomatic.
findings.suggestion: No wording change. QA should check a rendered row with "59分钟" for clipping.

findings.problem: The desktop/relay zh-CN (relay.notifications.age.minutes "# 分钟前") and some shipped mobile keys ("# 秒", "# 个监控") put a space after #. Other shipped keys ("再显示#个监控") do not. The draft follows the style guide rule of no space between CJK and digits, which is correct. The inconsistency elsewhere is pre-existing.
findings.suggestion: Keep the draft. Optionally normalise the older keys in a later pass.
